description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gemunupura, Rajanganaya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110020 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances) in various villages and divisions. The content is focused on land ownership, title settlements, and property registrations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters.
